routine.title: Lower — Power + Strength — Full
routine.notes: Main Monday lower session. Power first while fresh, then strength. Keep around 2 reps in reserve on strength work and do not chase fatigue on jumps. If Monday becomes a hard double football day, use Lower — Reduced instead.

exercises.notes: Explosive quality only. Reset fully between reps; stop if jump height or landing quality drops.
3 reps each side per set. Stick the landing and re-set; do not turn this into conditioning.
3 working sets of 5-7. Start around your current 80 kg working load. Add weight only once all sets are clean with about 2 reps in reserve.
Controlled eccentric and full hamstring tension. Work in the 5-7 rep range, no grinding.
6-10 reps each side. Keep pelvis controlled and use a range you can own.
2 strong sets of 6-8. Full lockout without overextending the lower back.
Straight-knee calf strength. Controlled full range, reps each side.
Bent-knee soleus work. 10-15 controlled reps with a pause at the top and full stretch at the bottom.
